P_CN11_S02: function P(knowledge,answer,score,ns){const all=load("all_units");const units=ns.map(n=>typeof n==="number"?"CN11-S02-P"+String(n).padStart(3,"0"):n);return {knowledge,answer,score,units,verified:true,verification_note:"逐序实际读中文第二节及实际观察原图后核源文「"+knowledge+"」；本题明确要求、答案与评分片段已逐点对应；有OCR或源文疑点的子句另记缺口。",source_excerpt:units.map(id=>all.find(x=>x.id===id)?.text||"").join("\n")};}
P_EN15_H017: function P(knowledge,answer,score,ns){const units=ns.map(n=>typeof n==="number"?"EN15-H017-H028-P"+String(n).padStart(3,"0"):n);return {knowledge,answer,score,units,verified:true,verification_note:"实际连续阅读英文GPCR节、原图后逐点核实「"+knowledge+"」的限定；明确题干所问、答案因果与评分必要项对应，图文歧义另留缺口。",source_excerpt:units.map(id=>load("all_units").find(x=>x.id===id)?.text||"").join("\n")};}
amendCard: function amendCard(id,e){const cards=load("cards"),ks=load("knowledge"),h=load("handling"),c=cards.find(c=>c.id===id);if(!c)throw Error(id);if(e.front)c.front=e.front;else if(e.question)c.front+=" "+e.question;for(const p of e.points||[]){const i=c.answer.length+1,a="A"+i,r="R"+i,kid="KP-CN"+c.chapter+"-"+String(ks.filter(k=>k.knowledge_id.startsWith("KP-CN"+c.chapter+"-")).length+1).padStart(4,"0");c.answer.push({anchor:a,text:p.answer});c.rubric.push({anchor:r,text:p.score});c.knowledge_ids.push(kid);ks.push({knowledge_id:kid,knowledge:p.knowledge,source_units:p.units,card_id:c.id,answer_anchor:a,rubric_anchor:r,explicit_recall:true,status:"covered",verified:p.verified,verification_note:p.verification_note,source_excerpt:p.source_excerpt,question_requirement:c.front,rubric_requirement:p.score});}const su=[...new Set((e.points||[]).flatMap(p=>p.units).concat(e.units||[]))];for(const u of su){if(!c.source_units.includes(u))c.source_units.push(u);const z=h[u]||{status:"mapped",cards:[],reason:e.reason||"实际读取并核实的新增点或重复支持已关联完整任务。"};if(!z.cards.includes(id))z.cards.push(id);h[u]=z;}for(const i of e.images||[])if(!c.images.some(q=>q.figure_id===i.figure_id))c.images.push(i);for(const k of ks.filter(k=>k.card_id===id))k.question_requirement=c.front;store("cards",cards);store("knowledge",ks);store("handling",h);return c.id;}
mergeSource: function mergeSource(id,ns,anchors,reason){const cs=load("cards"),ks=load("knowledge"),h=load("handling"),all=load("all_units"),c=cs.find(c=>c.id===id);const us=ns.map(n=>typeof n==="number"?"EN15-H017-H028-P"+String(n).padStart(3,"0"):n);for(const u of us){if(!c.source_units.includes(u))c.source_units.push(u);const z=h[u]||{status:"duplicate",cards:[],reason};if(!z.cards.includes(id))z.cards.push(id);h[u]=z;}for(const k of ks.filter(k=>k.card_id===id&&anchors.includes(k.answer_anchor))){for(const u of us)if(!k.source_units.includes(u))k.source_units.push(u);k.source_excerpt+="\n"+us.map(u=>all.find(x=>x.id===u)?.text||"").join("\n");k.verification_note+=" 新源实读后逐项对照："+reason;}store("cards",cs);store("knowledge",ks);store("handling",h);}
